title: Dark Night Pact
next_chapter_hook: When the Demonic Path Commander revealed that secret sealed for ten thousand ages, a crimson fissure suddenly tore open in the heavens outside the Observer's Hall—the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

text.content: Midnight. The Observer's Hall was lit by a flickering candle the size of a bean, stretching Chen Ji's shadow into a long, solitary line. He sat alone before a fractured star map, his fingers unconsciously tracing the edge of the Tianji Record Fragment, his brow slightly furrowed. Tonight's moonlight was unusual—a faint, elusive scent of blood seemed to hang in the air, as if some extremely dangerous presence was approaching. Suddenly, a wisp of black mist swept past the hall, carrying with it the unique chilling aura of the Demonic Path. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his right hand covertly gripping the talisman hidden in his sleeve as he low-whispered, "Since you're here, why not reveal yourself?"

dialogue.content: "The Observer is indeed sharp." The black mist dissipated, and a graceful figure stepped forth from the void—it was the Demonic Path Saint, Ye Qing. Tonight she wore no battle armor, only a flowing black gown. The usual fierce edge in her brow had softened considerably, replaced by an expression Chen Ji had never witnessed before—something profoundly complex. "I came alone. No one else knows."

text.content: Chen Ji did not relax his vigilance; instead, he subtly retreated a step, creating safe distance. His gaze was like a blade as it swept over Ye Qing, finally landing on the faintly visible dark purple mark between her eyebrows—that was the mark of Demonic Path seals, meaning she could be remotely controlled by the Holy Sect at any moment. "The Demonic Path Commander visits the heartland of Tianqing Sect in the dead of night. If others were to learn of this, even with a hundred mouths, it would be hard to explain." His voice was平静 as water, yet hiding a blade's edge. "Speak—what do you want from me?"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing did not answer immediately. Instead, she slowly walked toward the fractured star map in the hall's center. Her fingertips lightly brushed the cracked star tracks, and suddenly she laughed softly: "Observer's Hall—the most secret forbidden ground of Tianqing Sect. Every Sect Master throughout history has claimed this place holds ancient Heavenly Secrets fragments, yet no one has ever unraveled its mysteries." She turned to face Chen Ji directly, a glint of amusement flickering in her eyes. "But not only did you decipher it, you've also laid no fewer than seven layers of formations here. Chen Ji, you've truly hidden yourself deep."

text.content: A chill struck Chen Ji's heart, though his expression remained unchanged. He had always known Ye Qing was exceptionally intelligent, but he hadn't expected her to have investigated him to such an extent. He slowly rose, hands clasped behind his back, his voice growing colder: "Your Highness the Saint breaks into this forbidden ground in the dead of night—was it only to chat about old matters with me? Speak directly." Ye Qing's smile gradually faded, replaced by an unprecedented gravity: "I came to tell you a secret—one about the two of us."

The hall's candles suddenly flickered violently, as if pulled by some invisible force. Ye Qing took a deep breath, the dark purple mark between her eyebrows beginning to glow softly. Her voice was low and solemn: "Ten thousand years ago, in ancient times, there existed a forbidden being called the 'Heavenly Fate Reincarnation Body.' It was cleaved by heavenly tribulation into two halves—yang and yin. The yang half became a righteous leader, while the yin half fell into the Demonic Path's abyss. Though they became strangers, their fates remained endlessly entangled." She paused, her gaze sharp as a sword. "Do you think the Tianji Record chose you by coincidence?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He unconsciously gripped the Tianji Record Fragment hidden in his sleeve, his mind racing back to what Mo Xiansheng had once said—"The Tianji Record's choice of its master is never coincidence." He suppressed the turbulent waves in his heart, his voice still steady: "Are you saying... I am that yang half?" Ye Qing shook her head, a bitter smile tugging at her lips: "No. We are the two halves of the same soul. You are yang, I am yin; you master strategy, I master war; you guard the order of heaven, I disrupt the laws of the universe." Her voice suddenly rose. "Do you think the Demonic Path's invasion was coincidence? Do you think my choice to cooperate with you was chance?——It is the brand on our souls calling out to each other!"

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's earth-shaking secret leaves you momentarily stunned. Faced with this suddenly revealed "共同体", you decide...

choices.description: Suppressing your shock, continue to ask for more information about the Heavenly Fate Reincarnation Body, attempting to verify the truth of her words.
choices.risk_hint: If what she says is true, what does it mean? If false, what is she probing for?

text.content: Chen Ji slowly sat back down, his fingertips tapping the armrest, a glint of amusement flickering in his eyes: "Since you claim we share the same origin, do you have proof? Words alone mean nothing. Why should I believe you?" Upon hearing this, a flash of appreciation crossed Ye Qing's eyes: "Well said—Chen Ji who won't be convinced until he sees the coffin." She raised her right hand, fingers spread open, and a golden pattern appeared in her palm—exactly identical to the mark on Chen Ji's brow—the mark of the Tianji Record's master!

{\"dialogue.content: "This mark is called the 'Heavenly Fate Origin Seal.' Only the two halves split from the Heavenly Fate Reincarnation Body possess it simultaneously." Ye Qing's voice was low. "Your mark governs yang—mastering strategy; mine governs yin—mastering power. If you and I join forces, we become the complete Heavenly Fate Reincarnation Body—enough to overturn the three-realm structure."

choices.description: Whether her words are true or false, this notion of "destiny捆绑" is too terrifying. You choose to refuse directly and order her to leave.
choices.risk_hint: If what she says is true, is refusal wise? If false, why should you bother with such nonsense?

text.content: Chen Ji rose abruptly, sweeping his sleeve. The hall's formations activated with a thunderous roar, golden formation patterns like chains coiling toward Ye Qing: "Ridiculous! I am a disciple of Tianqing Sect, you are the Demonic Path Saint—what origin, what body—absolute nonsense!" Ye Qing's form remained utterly still; the restriction chains disintegrated automatically upon approaching within three feet of her. She sighed softly, "This reaction of yours... was entirely within my expectations."

choices.description: Whether true or false, first pretend to believe, extract all her cards and intentions, then decide.
choices.risk_hint: If she sees through your act, the consequences would be unimaginable.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed lightly, that smile carrying a hint of profound meaning: 'Same origin, same body... interesting.' He sat back down, his posture relaxing slightly, 'Since fate has arranged it this way, Holy Maiden, coming to me in the middle of the night, surely it's not just to tell me this truth? What exactly do you want?' A flash of appreciation appeared in Ye Qing's eyes, 'You're indeed a smart one.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suppressed the excitement from moments ago, restoring that cold, aloof expression: 'What do I want? I want to survive, to break free from the Holy Sect's shackles, to no longer be a chess piece in someone else's hand.' She paused, her voice suddenly dropping lower, 'And you... you should know better than anyone what the price of the Tianji Record is. Every time you peer into the future, it consumes your Heavenly Fate Value—how many more times can you endure?' This sentence struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. He unconsciously clenched the fragment, a chill rising in his heart. Heavenly Fate Value... he had almost none left.

text.content: The night wind outside the hall suddenly turned biting, carrying a faint scent of blood. Ye Qing stepped forward, closing the distance between them until they could almost feel each other's breath: 'My "Demonic Path Fog" can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, preventing the Eyes of Heaven from peering. And your Tianji Record can foresee when and where our enemies will strike.' Her voice was like a bewitching demonic melody, 'Yin and yang combined, invincible under heaven—isn't this the simplest principle?'

dialogue.content: 'But this comes with a price.' Ye Qing's gaze deepened. 'When the two halves of the soul fully merge, that is when the Heavenly Fate Reincarnation Body is reborn. At that point, we will no longer be Chen Ji and Ye Qing, but a single brand-new existence merged into one.' She looked at Chen Ji, a complex smile curving her lips. 'So I give you a choice—maintain independence and cooperate briefly with me; or accept the merger and bear the full weight of destiny.' Chen Ji's heart lurched violently. What did merger mean? Losing oneself? Or transcending everything? Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned any of this—no, perhaps he simply didn't know.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing posed an ultimate choice: brief cooperation or accepting the merger. You weighed the pros and cons in your heart, but first, you need to confirm one thing...

choices.description: Temporarily accept the cooperation proposal, but keep your trump cards and maintain room to withdraw at any time.
choices.visible_cost: Need to share part of the Tianji Record information
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the protection of the Demonic Path Fog
choices.risk_hint: If she betrays you midway, you will be attacked from both front and back.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly extended his hand: 'Alright, we cooperate. But there is one condition—we each keep our final trump card, and before the merger, neither can force the other.' Ye Qing stared at that hand, a flash of emotion crossing her eyes, then she too extended her hand, their palms meeting. Two golden and purple lights burst forth at the point of contact, then quickly subsided to calm. 'Deal.' Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of relief, 'Pleasure working with you, "the other half".'

{\"text.content: Just as their palms touched, a blurry image suddenly flashed through Chen Ji's mind—it was a page in the depths of the Tianji Record that had never been unlocked before, clearly bearing four characters: 'Heavenly Fate Same Origin'. His pupils constricted sharply, his heart churning like vast waves. These four characters... Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned them! Could Ye Qing's words actually be true?

choices.description: No matter what, you will not abandon yourself. You would rather fight separately than accept a merger that costs your sense of self.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the possibility of deep cooperation
choices.risk_hint: Without Ye Qing's full cooperation, your layout in the Demonic Path will face immense difficulties.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his hand, shaking his head: 'I can cooperate with you, but I cannot accept the merger. I am Chen Ji, the one and only Chen Ji—not a subordinate of any existence.' Ye Qing's expression stiffened slightly, then regained composure, though her eyes held a complex emotion difficult to describe: 'You are indeed... more stubborn than I imagined. Very well, let's each take a step back—we cooperate, but retain the right to withdraw at any time. How about that?'

choices.description: Since you speak so mysteriously, you should provide some concrete evidence. Let me see the power of that 'Heavenly Fate Same Origin Seal'.
choices.visible_reward: Verify the truth with your own eyes
choices.risk_hint: "If the mark loses control, the consequences are unpredictable."

text.content: Chen Ji did not retreat, but instead stepped forward, his burning gaze fixed on the mark in Ye Qing's palm: "Since you say this mark is so miraculous, why not let me witness its power firsthand?" Ye Qing was slightly stunned, then laughed lightly: "Bold spirit." She flipped her palm over, and the golden patterns suddenly blazed to life. A mighty force burst forth from it—and that power resonated with the Tianji Record's energy within Chen Ji, causing the mark at his brow center to glow as well! In an instant, the air between them twisted, as if some invisible shackle was taking shape.

{\"text.content: "Do you feel it?" Ye Qing's voice grew distant. "This is the power of Heavenly Fate Resonance. No matter how far apart we are, if one of us is in danger, the other senses it immediately—this is a soul-level connection, unbreakable." Chen Ji felt the slightly burning mark at his brow center, his heart a complex mixture of emotions. This power... it truly is real.

dialogue.content: At that moment, Ye Qing's expression suddenly changed. She猛地 retreated three steps, the dark purple mark at her brow center flickering wildly: "Bad... the Holy Sect has detected the anomaly and is pinpointing my location." Her voice grew urgent. "I must leave. But before I go, there is one more piece of news for you—regarding your bloodline's origin." Chen Ji's heart leaped: "What news?" Ye Qing took a deep breath, speaking each word clearly: "You are not an ordinary human. Your bloodline descends from the first generation of Heavenly Fate Bearers in ancient times—Chen Xuan."

text.content: Chen Xuan. That name was like thunder exploding in Chen Ji's mind. The original holder of the Tianji Record, the existence revered as the standard by all prophets throughout history—was actually Chen Ji's ancestor?! "Before ascending, Chen Xuan sealed a drop of his refined blood deep within the Tianji Record, waiting for a destined person to awaken." Ye Qing's voice grew more urgent. "And you... are the chosen one. This is why the Tianji Record sought you out—it's not coincidence, it's the call of bloodline!" A sharp whistling sound suddenly pierced the air outside the hall. Ye Qing's face changed drastically: "There's no time! I must go—remember, in three days, at the entrance to the Demonic Path's secret realm, I will be waiting!" Before her words even finished, she had turned into a wisp of black smoke, vanishing into the night.

Chen Ji stood alone in the empty hall, long speechless. His hand unconsciously touched his brow center, where the lingering warmth from the resonance with Ye Qing still remained. Heavenly Fate Reincarnation Body, Chen Xuan's bloodline, Heavenly Fate Resonance Mark... one by one, secrets sealed for ten thousand years surged forth like a tide, shattering the clarity of his originally well-laid life chess game. He slowly sat on the ground, closed his eyes, and began rapidly deducing all the possibilities in his mind. If what Ye Qing said was true, then all his plans would be completely overturned—because he was no longer fighting alone, but carrying the fate of that forbidden existence from ten thousand years ago. If her words were false... then why did she visit in the dead of night, with what intention? At that moment, the Tianji Record Fragment flipped open on its own, and Mo Xiansheng's aged voice emerged from within: "Chen Xuan... so that's it. So that's it! This old man finally understands!"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice carried uncontrollable excitement: "No wonder the Tianji Record chose you, no wonder Chen Xuan's inheritance fell upon you—it was all destined ten thousand years ago!" Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, his voice deep: "Mo Xiansheng, what do you know?" The remnant soul was silent for a moment before speaking slowly: "Ten thousand years ago, after the Heavenly Fate Reincarnation Body was struck by heavenly tribulation and shattered, Chen Xuan was precisely the remnant of willpower from the yang aspect. After his ascension failed, he sealed his entire life's cultivation within the Tianji Record, solely to wait for the day he could retrieve the yin aspect and complete the reincarnation." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a trace of sorrow. "And you... are the person Chen Xuan exhausted his final Heavenly Fate to wait for. Your bloodline, your aptitude, your compatibility with the Tianji Record—all were pieces arranged by Chen Xuan ten thousand years ago."

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the churning emotions in his heart. He slowly stood up, his gaze falling on the sky outside the hall shrouded in night. The moon had completely hidden behind the clouds, leaving only a dense darkness, as if some enormous existence was secretly watching. In three days, the Demonic Path's secret realm... This was a choice capable of changing everything. Accepting the invitation meant stepping into the very core of the true chess game, confronting fate head-on; refusing meant continuing to fight alone, surviving through the grinding pressures of three major sects. But no matter the choice, one thing was certain—he could no longer turn back. The Tianji Record Fragment flipped open again, and Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded one final time: "Chen Ji, no matter what choice you make, remember one thing: fate can be rewritten, but the前提是你必须先看清它的全貌。 And now, what you see... is merely the tip of the iceberg." With the words finished, the fragment fell silent. Outside the hall, a blood-red light quietly streaked across the sky—that was the gaze of the Heavenly Eye—it had already sensed everything that happened tonight.

Chen Ji stood atop the ruins of the Observer's Hall, watching that fleeting blood-red light. A cold smile suddenly curved his lips. The Heavenly Eye? The ultimate antagonist? Every step Chen Ji had taken from a废物 servant to today was crawled out from among the dead. Want to use him as a chess piece? Fine, then let's see who ends up consuming whom in the end. He turned and walked back into the hall, picked up the Tianji Record Fragment, and began deducing the situation three days from now on the star chart. Whether Ye Qing's words were true or false, one thing was certain—the Demonic Path's secret realm held secrets capable of overturning the three realms. And Chen Ji had never feared any secret. "The three-day deadline..." he murmured to himself, the mark at his brow center faintly glowing. "Interesting."
